findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a story review has an open P0 Not done finding and a dismissed P1 with the same title and file.
An owner-approved Not done finding blocks regardless of its scores: review.py:189-195 checks required_done_when separately. If the open P0 has a below-bar score, however, score.holds(e) is false, so this condition still adds the undismissed P0 to the settlement ceiling. A repeated P0 then passes the ceiling check and inherits the P1's dismissal. The ordinary dismissal survives bound_review, allowing close to mark the review clean without settling the P0.

Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - a repair review reports a serious finding beside the moved, dismissed finding.
The changed test now checks the moved line, close's result and the pull request text, but it still never runs forge work or checks the builder's brief. It would pass if close blocked correctly while the worker omitted the serious same-title finding from the brief, leaving that promised behavior unproved.
